shellCommands.command: npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -50
ls -la /workspace/.next/types 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---"; git -C /workspace stash; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; git -C /workspace stash pop
rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -60
rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -60

npx next start -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
echo "started"

sleep 1
echo "--- Full page render (should include title AND details after 800ms) ---"
time curl -s http://localhost:3100/projects/acme
echo
echo "--- RSC prefetch payload (simulates Link prefetch; should have title but NOT details) ---"
curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3100/projects/acme
kill %1 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

npx next start -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 & sleep 2 echo "--- Timed full page load (should take ~800ms+ due to dynamic details) ---" time curl -s http://localhost:3100/projects/acme -o /tmp/full.html grep -o '

[^<]*

' /tmp/full.html grep -o 'Commerce storefront[^"]*' /tmp/full.html echo echo "--- Prefetch payload (RSC + prefetch headers; should resolve instantly with title but WITHOUT details) ---" time curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D" http://localhost:3100/projects/acme -o /tmp/prefetch.txt cat /tmp/prefetch.txt
cat /tmp/next-start.log; echo "---"; lsof -i :3100 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1

fuser -k 3100/tcp 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; npx next start -p 3101 > /tmp/next-start2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
cat /tmp/next-start2.log

echo "--- Full page load (dynamic, should take ~800ms) ---" time curl -s http://localhost:3101/projects/acme -o /tmp/full.html grep -o '

[^<]*

' /tmp/full.html echo echo "--- Prefetch payload (should be instant, title present, details deferred/absent) ---" time curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D" http://localhost:3101/projects/acme echo

curl -sv -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D" http://localhost:3101/projects/acme -o /tmp/prefetch2.txt 2>&1 | tail -20
echo "=== BODY ==="
cat /tmp/prefetch2.txt

time curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D" "http://localhost:3101/projects/acme?_rsc=dqR7R9QVVV_bHJGW" -o /tmp/prefetch3.txt
cat /tmp/prefetch3.txt
echo
echo "=== does it contain details text? ==="
grep -o "Commerce storefront" /tmp/prefetch3.txt || echo "NOT FOUND (details excluded, as expected)"
echo "=== does it contain title? ==="
grep -o "Acme Storefront" /tmp/prefetch3.txt || echo "NOT FOUND"
wc -l /tmp/prefetch3.txt; echo "---full content---"; cat -A /tmp/prefetch3.txt | head -50

curl -sv -L -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D" "http://localhost:3101/projects/acme?_rsc=dqR7R9QVVV_bHJGW" -o /tmp/prefetch4.txt 2>&1 | tail -30
echo "=== body ==="
cat /tmp/prefetch4.txt

curl -s -D - -L -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D" -H "Next-Url: /" "http://localhost:3101/projects/acme" -o /tmp/prefetch5.txt
echo "=== body ==="
cat /tmp/prefetch5.txt
(ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i playwright; npx playwright --version 2>&1 | head -5)
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git -C /workspace status
rm -f /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git -C /workspace status

cat /workspace/.gitignore 2>/dev/null; echo "---tsconfig diff---"; git -C /workspace diff tsconfig.json; echo "---package.json diff (pre-existing, not mine)---"; git -C /workspace diff package.json | head -20

git -C /workspace checkout -- tsconfig.json
rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/next-env.d.ts
git -C /workspace status
git -C /workspace diff app/projects/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/data.ts
